title: October 22, 2008: India sent its first spacecraft to the Moon.

sources.text: NASA NSSDC - Chandrayaan-1 press release archive

caption:
October 22, 2008: India sent its first spacecraft to the Moon.

The 1,380 kg spacecraft carried 11 scientific instruments - from India, the US, UK, Germany, Sweden and Bulgaria - into a transfer orbit before reaching the Moon on November 8, 2008.

The mission concluded when communication was lost in August 2009 - but it had already made India one of the handful of countries to successfully send a spacecraft to the Moon.

Chandrayaan-1 proved India's space program could design, build and fly an interplanetary mission - groundwork that led directly to Chandrayaan-2, Chandrayaan-3's lunar landing and India's growing space ambitions since.
